messages:
maria: Quick q — UX for automatic fallback policy thresholds: should we expose separate sliders for latency / error-rate / queue-depth vs a single 'health score' control? thinking about simplicity vs flexibility. mock: https://redwood.app/console/proto/fallback-ui :thinking:
kevin: i'd keep separate metrics. ops wants granularity, but agreed on presets (safe, balanced, aggressive) to avoid confusion for newcomers.
olivia: presets + advanced toggle. also need clear degrade-mode labels & examples. suggestions:
  - silent_degrade: switch to smaller model, no banner, lowest cost impact
  - graceful_degrade: smaller model + inline banner + reduced features (no long generations)
  - failover_route: route to fallback service (embeddings/rerank only)
these need one-line tooltips.
sam: telemetry question — for audit we need per-request trace: original_model, chosen_fallback, trigger_reason, latency_ms, http_status. retention default 90d, sampling for high-volume routes. also want an export CSV button for investigative runs.
aaron: +1. API suggestion: add a simulation endpoint: POST /policies/simulate with sample traffic or histograms to preview fallback rate and cost delta. server-side sim for accuracy, client-side quick estimate for instant feedback.
deploy-bot: policy-sim job queued — id: sim-9832 — ETA ~3m. will post results to #eng-platform when ready. :robot_face:
kevin: UI pieces: small panel with timeline of triggers, histogram of fallback counts, top 5 trigger rules, and a "what-if" slider to tweak thresholds and re-run simulation. show projected p50/p95 latency and cost per 1M tokens.
maria: i want the what-if to be instant (client-side) for exploration, but a server-side sim button is necessary before applying changes. also we should show recommended safe threshold based on historical traffic.
olivia: another UX point — when rollout % < 100, show expected fallback delta for each pct bucket. and a clear "undo" with changelog link.
sam: telemetry panel mock plan:
  - top row: current rollout status + active degrade mode
  - middle: triggers by reason (latency / 5xx / queue_depth) pie + trend sparkline
  - bottom: sample traces table (click -> trace view) + export
will attach screens by EOW.
aaron: small API debate — should policy rules encode metric units or be metric-agnostic? propose explicit metric objects: `{"metric":"p95_latency_ms","op":">","value":"120"}` so there's no ambiguity.
maria: agree, explicit metric names in policy schema. also add human-readable display_name for UI.
kevin: also think about defaults for enterprise: stricter thresholds, longer retention, and opt-in verbose tracing. add flag `verbose_audit: true` at org-level.
olivia: copy note: we need short, non-technical labels for degrade modes for customer-facing docs. i'll draft wording.
sam: sample payload for sim endpoint idea:
```
POST /policies/simulate
{
  "policy_id": "p-123",
  "traffic_profile": {"route":"/generate","qps":50,"avg_len":120},
  "period_hours":24
}
```
response should include projected_fallback_count, projected_cost_delta, breakdown_by_reason.
aaron: perfect. also include error triggers: 5xx_ratio > 0.02, p95_latency_ms > 200, queue_depth > 50.
maria: action items: kevin -> update policy API spec (metric schema + simulate endpoint); sam -> telemetry panel mock + retention options; olivia -> degrade-mode copy + tooltips; aaron -> simulate endpoint server design; maria -> console mock + presets. sync Thu 10am.
maria: thanks all :thumbsup:
